candidates.change_summary: Delete the owner check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Delete the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are attempted.
Replace the positive-amount check with an always-true check so zero-amount calls succeed without reverting.
Transfer one wei less than requested, so the receiver gets amount-1 instead of amount.
Send the funds to msg.sender instead of the requested receiver.
Move the owner check after the transfer, so any caller can transfer and the check only reverts afterward.
